Scaled complex Wishart model for PolSAR data (R6)

Source: R/models.R
WishartSAR.Rd

R6 class for the scaled complex Wishart law \(\mathcal{W}_m(\Sigma, L)\) (see dwishart_sar()). The maximum likelihood estimator of \(\Sigma\) is the sample mean and \(L\) solves \(m\log L - \psi^{(0)}_m(L) = \log|\bar Z| - \overline{\log|Z|}\) (Anfinsen et al., 2009). The entropy variance is available in closed form (Nascimento, Ferreira and Frery, 2023).

References

Anfinsen, S. N., Doulgeris, A. P. and Eltoft, T. (2009). Estimation of the equivalent number of looks in polarimetric synthetic aperture radar imagery. IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, 47(11), 3795–3809.

Examples

set.seed(1)
Z <- rwishart_sar(300, polsar_example_sigma("forest"), L = 4)
m <- WishartSAR$new()$fit(Z)
m
#> <Scaled complex Wishart> fitted to n = 300 observations
#>   Sigma:
#>                  [,1]              [,2]              [,3]
#> [1,] 0.34230+0.00000i 0.013160+0.00643i 0.059910-0.00602i
#> [2,] 0.01316-0.00643i 0.101100+0.00000i 0.001538+0.00261i
#> [3,] 0.05991+0.00602i 0.001538-0.00261i 0.212300+0.00000i
#>   L = 3.97893
#>   logLik = 3618.44
#>   Shannon entropy = -12.0615
m$entropy_variance()
#> [1] 0.02448245
